name: Cost-Aware Optimizer
description: Moves idle stablecoin into the Venus Core-pool market paying the best rate, and only when that rate clears the cost of moving it. Concentrates without limit: where the best net rate is, the capital goes. Acts through vToken.mint(uint256), which takes an amount and no recipient. Reference agent built from the BNB Agent Studio scaffold and self-hosted by the MANDATE team.

skills.name: Deploy idle capital at the best supported rate
skills.description: Reads the Venus Core-pool stablecoin markets, ranks the ones accepting supply by their annualised rate net of a cost buffer, and proposes a mint(uint256) that moves idle wallet capital into the best of them. Returns a proposed action; it never executes one.
